description: What tools/run.py faces shows (docs/faces.md): the review heads (an assembler recipe), the two skin tones of the final test, per-head iris and brow colours, and the game's first-person camera read from the game repo (D:/prime-game, read only, 2026-10-03 at c43c0e1): client/player/player.tscn has a Camera3D with no fov set, so Godot's default 75 degrees vertical (keep height); content/modes/base_mode.tres eye_height_m = 1.6; project.godot sets no anti-aliasing (MSAA and screen-space AA off) and stretch mode canvas_items; the target screen is 1920 x 1080. Brows: one colour per head, and a darker one on the dark skin (brow_by_skin) so that they keep a contrast of at least 3 on both skins. motion: the pack actions in which the decals' clearance from the deforming skin is measured. spacing_sheet: the eye spacing variants (eyes.inset) for the near-human question.

facial_hair.description: Input for the engineer's open question (facial hair on both body types or not): the men's pack facial hair, split off its source heads and put on one man's and one woman's review head, coloured like the brows. Shown, not decided.
